source.text: Biopsy-proven metastatic non-small cell lung cancer
Biopsy-proven metastatic non-small cell lung cancer
At least one measurable (RECIST 1.1) indicator lesion not previously irradiated
Somatic activating mutation in EGFR in pre-treatment tumor biopsy or cfDNA (including all mutations with sensitivity to osimertinib) by any CLIA certified assay.
Prior exposure to anti-PD-1 inhibitor therapy
Prior exposure to antibody drug conjugate (ADC) containing chemotherapeutic agent targeting topoisomerase I, TROP2 antibody (Study Cohort A only).
Active (eg, with disease modifying drugs, prednisone \>10 mg daily or equivalent, immunosuppressant therapy) or prior documented autoimmune or inflammatory disorders

Unstable angina, myocardial infarction, congestive heart failure (New York Heart Association \[NYHA\] classification ≥ grade 2) or unstable vascular disease (eg, aortic aneurysm at risk of rupture, Moyamoya disease) that required hospitalization within 12 months prior to first study drug treatment
Malignancy treated with curative intent and with no known active disease ≥ 2 years before the first dose of study drugs and of low potential risk for recurrence

Symptomatic CNS metastases, CNS metastases with hemorrhagic features, CNS radiation within 7 days prior to first study drug treatment, potential need for CNS radiation within the first cycle, or symptomatic leptomeningeal disease.
History of interstitial lung disease (ILD) requiring steroids
Known history of human immunodeficiency virus (HIV) whose viral load is not controlled.
Known history of allogeneic organ transplantation or allogeneic hematopoietic stem cell transplantation
All patients with active hepatitis C (hepatitis C virus \[HCV\] antibody positive with HCV RNA levels above the lower limit of detection) are excluded.
Current use of systemic corticosteroids (\>10 mg daily prednisone or equivalent)
